systems.notes: Polaris React is deprecated and its docs site (polaris-react.shopify.com) now redirects to shopify.dev. React entries come from the official archived Storybook plus the old site's Deprecated list. 'url' points to the live web-component page when one exists, else to the archived Storybook story; legacy_docs_url is the old (redirecting) polaris-react.shopify.com path. implementations: react-legacy, web-components (s-* tags, App Home), app-bridge-web-components.

components.name: Account connection
components.purpose: Card that lets a merchant connect or disconnect a third-party account.

components.name: Action list
components.purpose: List of actions or links, usually shown inside a popover.
components.notes: Web-components equivalent is Menu (s-menu).

components.name: App provider
components.purpose: Root wrapper that supplies i18n, theme and link settings to all Polaris components.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.purpose: Text field that filters and suggests options from a list as the user types.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Shows a person's or business's picture or initials.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small colored label for an object's status or attribute.
components.notes: Tone + progress variants; other systems split this into StatusLight/StateLabel vs Label/Tag.

components.name: Banner
components.purpose: Prominent message about an important change or persistent condition.
components.notes: Tone variants (info/success/warning/critical).

components.name: Bleed
components.purpose: Applies negative margins so content can extend into a parent's padding.

components.name: Block stack
components.purpose: Stacks children vertically with consistent spacing.
components.notes: Web components merge BlockStack/InlineStack into Stack (s-stack).

components.name: Box
components.purpose: Generic container that applies spacing, borders, background and other style tokens.

components.name: Bulk actions
components.purpose: Bar of actions applied to several selected rows at once.
components.notes: Only in the archived Storybook; on the old docs site it was part of IndexTable/ResourceList, not its own page.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Triggers an action or navigates when clicked.
components.notes: Variants primary/secondary/tertiary/plain/monochromePlain and tone=critical; used as a link via url prop. Other systems split plain/link-styled buttons out (e.g., LinkButton, IconButton).

components.name: Button group
components.purpose: Arranges several related buttons together.
components.notes: variant=segmented acts like a segmented control.

components.name: Callout card
components.purpose: Card that promotes a feature or next step with an illustration and call to action.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Surface that groups related content and actions.
components.notes: Web-components equivalent is Section (s-section).

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Lets the user turn a single option on or off, or pick several options.

components.name: Choice list
components.purpose: Group of radio buttons or checkboxes for picking one or many options.
components.notes: Covers both RadioGroup and CheckboxGroup from other systems (allowMultiple).

components.name: Collapsible
components.purpose: Shows or hides a section of content.

components.name: Color picker
components.purpose: Lets the user pick a color visually (hue, saturation/brightness, alpha).

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Text input with a popover list of options for single or multi select.

components.name: Contextual save bar
components.purpose: Top bar telling the merchant they have unsaved changes, with Save and Discard.
components.notes: Replaced by the App Bridge Save bar.

components.name: Data table
components.purpose: Table for displaying and comparing rows of data with sorting and totals.
components.notes: Web-components equivalent is Table (s-table).

components.name: Date picker
components.purpose: Calendar for picking a single date or a date range.

components.name: Description list
components.purpose: List of terms paired with their descriptions.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: Horizontal or vertical line that separates content.

components.name: Drop zone
components.purpose: Area where users drag and drop or browse to upload files.

components.name: Empty state
components.purpose: Explains why there is no content yet and what to do next.

components.name: Exception list
components.purpose: Compact list of warnings or notable details about an object.

components.name: Filters
components.purpose: Search box plus filter controls for narrowing a list of resources.

components.name: Footer help
components.purpose: Footer link pointing merchants to help docs for the page.

components.name: Form
components.purpose: Wraps form fields and handles native form submission.

components.name: Form layout
components.purpose: Arranges form fields in consistent rows and groups.

components.name: Frame
components.purpose: Top-level app structure holding top bar, navigation, toasts and loading.

components.name: Fullscreen bar
components.purpose: Top bar with a back/exit action for full-screen app views.

components.name: Grid
components.purpose: Responsive column grid for arranging content.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Displays an icon from the Polaris icon set.

components.name: Index filters

components.name: Index table

components.name: Inline error
components.purpose: Short error message shown next to a form field.

components.name: Inline grid
components.purpose: Places children in columns across a row with responsive widths.

components.name: Inline stack
components.purpose: Arranges children horizontally with spacing, alignment and wrapping.

components.name: Keyboard key
components.purpose: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut as a styled key cap.

components.name: Layout

components.name: Legacy card

components.name: Legacy filters
components.purpose: Older filter bar for resource lists.

components.name: Legacy stack

components.name: Legacy tabs
components.purpose: Older tab bar.

components.name: Link

components.name: List

components.name: Listbox

components.name: Loading

components.name: Media card

components.name: Modal

components.name: Navigation

components.name: Option list

components.name: Page

components.name: Page actions

components.name: Pagination

components.name: Popover

components.name: Progress bar

components.name: Radio button

components.name: Range slider

components.name: Resource item

components.name: Scrollable

components.name: Select

components.name: Select all actions

components.name: Setting toggle

components.name: Shadow bevel

components.name: Sheet

components.name: Skeleton body text

components.name: Skeleton display text

components.name: Skeleton page

components.name: Skeleton tabs

components.name: Skeleton thumbnail
components.purpose: Placeholder for a thumbnail image while it loads.

components.name: Spinner

components.name: Tabs

components.name: Tag

components.name: Text

components.name: Text container

components.name: Text field

components.name: Theme provider

components.name: Thumbnail

components.name: Toast

components.name: Tooltip

components.name: Video thumbnail

components.name: Caption

components.name: Display text

components.name: Heading

components.name: Subheading

components.name: Text style

systems.notes: 62 public components from the React components index (Rails/Figma share the same pages). internal:true marks the 25 'Internal components' pages (GitHub-internal, not in @primer/react). Not listed in the docs index and therefore not included: legacy @primer/react exports such as Box, Octicon, Portal, Hidden, Header, SubNav, TabNav, SideNav, Pagehead, Flash. Per-component status (alpha/beta/stable/deprecated) is rendered client-side and was not captured.

systems.notes: React Spectrum S2 (@react-spectrum/s2, now the default docs at react-spectrum.adobe.com) is the primary list. React Spectrum v3 (now at /v3/) entries are merged in; v3-only ones have implementations ['react-spectrum-v3']. AI components are a preview package. spectrum.adobe.com is the original (Spectrum 1-era) design-guideline site; its nav is client-rendered, so guideline-only components were taken from its sitemap and flagged 'spectrum-guidelines'. Deprecated guideline pages (Bar loader, Circle loader, Dropdown, Tool, Quick actions) are folded into their successors' notes. There is no public standalone S2 guidelines site (s2.spectrum.adobe.com is an overview page).

components.notes: Replaces deprecated 'Quick actions' guideline.

components.name: ActionButton
components.purpose: Quiet or subtle button for task actions, often icon-only, in toolbars.
components.notes: Separate from Button in Spectrum; 'Tool' guideline was merged into it.

components.name: ActionButtonGroup
components.purpose: Group of related ActionButtons with overflow handling.
components.notes: S2 splits v3 ActionGroup into ActionButtonGroup (actions) and ToggleButtonGroup (selection).

components.name: ActionMenu
components.purpose: ActionButton that opens a menu for 'more actions'.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Thumbnail image for a user or organization.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.purpose: Group of related avatars shown together.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small color-coded label for metadata or status.
components.notes: S2 also exports NotificationBadge (count/dot), which has no dedicated docs page.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Shows the user's location in a hierarchy and lets them go up levels.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Main button for performing an action.
components.notes: Variants accent/primary/secondary/negative, fill/outline; LinkButton is separate.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.purpose: Group of related buttons that handles overflow by stacking.

components.name: Calendar
components.purpose: Month grid for picking a single date (or multiple dates).

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Summary of an object the user can select or open.
components.notes: Same page documents AssetCard, UserCard and ProductCard, which are separate components in other systems.

components.name: CardView
components.purpose: Grid of cards with selection and bulk actions.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Lets the user turn an option on or off.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.purpose: Group of checkboxes for picking several options.

components.name: ColorArea
components.purpose: 2D area for adjusting two channels of a color.

components.name: ColorField
components.purpose: Text field for editing a hex color or a single color channel.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.purpose: Swatch button that opens a popover with color editing controls.
components.notes: v3 only; S2 composes ColorArea/ColorSlider/ColorSwatchPicker instead.

components.name: ColorSlider
components.purpose: Slider for adjusting one channel of a color.

components.name: ColorSwatch
components.purpose: Shows a preview of a color.
components.notes: Design guidelines call it 'Swatch'.

components.name: ColorSwatchPicker
components.purpose: Grid of color swatches to pick from.
components.notes: Design guidelines call it 'Swatch group'.

components.name: ColorWheel
components.purpose: Circular track for adjusting the hue of a color.

components.name: ComboBox
components.purpose: Text field with a dropdown list for filtering and choosing one option.

components.name: ContextualHelp
components.purpose: Info or help icon button that opens a popover with extra explanation.

components.name: DateField
components.purpose: Keyboard-editable field for a date and optional time.

components.name: DatePicker
components.purpose: Date field with a calendar popover for choosing a date.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.purpose: Two date fields with a range calendar popover for choosing a start and end date.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Modal window for contextual information, tasks or decisions.
components.notes: S2 page documents Dialog, AlertDialog, FullscreenDialog, CustomDialog, DialogTrigger and DialogContainer. v3 had type='tray' / 'popover' variants; Tray is its own guideline.

components.name: Disclosure
components.purpose: Single collapsible section with a header and panel.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: Line that separates content.

components.name: DropZone
components.purpose: Area into which files or objects can be dragged and dropped.

components.name: Form
components.purpose: Groups form fields with consistent label alignment, sizing and validation behavior.

components.name: IllustratedMessage
components.purpose: Illustration with a heading and message, used for empty states and errors.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Image with skeleton loading and custom error states.

components.name: InlineAlert
components.purpose: Non-modal message tied to content in the page.

components.name: LabeledValue
components.purpose: Non-editable value with a label, formatted for numbers, dates or lists.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Text link to another location.

components.name: LinkButton
components.purpose: Link that looks like a Button.

components.name: ListView
components.purpose: Interactive list of items with selection, actions and drag and drop.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: List of actions or options shown from a trigger.
components.notes: Includes MenuTrigger, SubmenuTrigger, sections, unavailable items and context menus.

components.name: Meter
components.purpose: Shows a quantity or level within a known range.

components.name: NumberField
components.purpose: Number input with increment/decrement steppers.

components.name: Picker
components.purpose: Dropdown for choosing one option from a list.
components.notes: Formerly 'Dropdown' in the guidelines.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Overlay positioned next to a trigger holding content or controls.
components.notes: In v3 this was a Dialog type.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.purpose: Horizontal bar showing progress of an operation.
components.notes: Formerly 'Bar loader'.

components.name: ProgressCircle
components.purpose: Circular indicator of progress or loading.
components.notes: Formerly 'Circle loader'.

components.name: Provider
components.purpose: Root container that sets theme, color scheme, locale and scale for its children.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.purpose: Group of radio buttons for choosing one option.

components.name: RangeCalendar
components.purpose: Month grid for choosing a date range.

components.name: RangeSlider
components.purpose: Slider with two handles for choosing a range.

components.name: SearchField
components.purpose: Text field for search with a clear button.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.purpose: Row of mutually exclusive buttons for switching views.

components.name: SelectBoxGroup
components.purpose: Large selectable boxes for choosing one or more options.

components.name: SideNav
components.purpose: Sidebar navigation of nested, hierarchical links.
components.notes: Guideline name: Side navigation.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Wraps content to render it as a loading placeholder.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Lets the user pick a value within a range by dragging.

components.name: StatusLight
components.purpose: Colored dot with a label to show status or category.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Turns a single option on or off.

components.name: TableView
components.purpose: Table for scanning, sorting, selecting and acting on data.
components.notes: Supports expandable rows, drag and drop, TableFooter.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Organizes content into sections the user switches between.

components.name: TagGroup
components.purpose: Group of tags for keywords or categories, optionally removable.

components.name: TextArea
components.purpose: Multi-line text input.

components.name: TextField
components.purpose: Single-line text input.

components.name: TimeField
components.purpose: Keyboard-editable field for a time value.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Brief notification that appears temporarily, optionally with an action.
components.notes: Uses ToastContainer + ToastQueue.

components.name: ToggleButton
components.purpose: Button that toggles between selected and unselected.

components.name: ToggleButtonGroup
components.purpose: Group of ToggleButtons with single or multiple selection.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Short label shown on hover or focus of a control.

components.name: TreeView
components.purpose: Hierarchical list with expandable items and selection.

components.name: ActionGroup
components.purpose: Group of ActionButtons with optional selection and overflow.
components.notes: v3 only; split into ActionButtonGroup and ToggleButtonGroup in S2.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.purpose: Dialog asking the user to confirm or acknowledge something.
components.notes: Separate page in v3; documented on the Dialog page in S2.

components.name: Content
components.purpose: Slot wrapper for the main content of a component (e.g. Dialog body).
components.notes: v3 page; still exported by S2 as a slot component.

components.name: DialogContainer
components.purpose: Shows a dialog programmatically without a trigger.

components.name: DialogTrigger
components.purpose: Connects a trigger button to a dialog or popover.

components.name: FileTrigger
components.purpose: Wraps a button to open the system file picker.

components.name: Flex
components.purpose: Flexbox layout container.
components.notes: v3 only; S2 uses the style macro instead.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Slot for footer content in dialogs and other components.

components.name: Grid
components.purpose: CSS grid layout container.
components.notes: v3 only.

components.name: Header
components.purpose: Slot for header content in dialogs and other components.

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: Heading text slot.
components.notes: Also a Spectrum guideline typography component.

components.name: Keyboard
components.purpose: Shows a keyboard shortcut.

components.name: ListBox
components.purpose: Plain list of selectable options.
components.notes: v3 only as a standalone component.

components.name: LogicButton
components.purpose: Button for choosing a boolean operator (and/or) between conditions.

components.name: MenuTrigger
components.purpose: Connects a button to a Menu.
components.notes: Documented on the Menu page in S2.

components.name: SearchAutocomplete
components.purpose: Search field with a list of suggestions.

components.name: StepList
components.purpose: Shows steps in a process and lets the user move between them.

components.name: Text
components.purpose: Plain text slot.

components.name: View
components.purpose: General-purpose container with Spectrum style props.
components.notes: v3 only; Spectrum's Box equivalent.

components.name: Well
components.purpose: Container that sets non-editable content apart, e.g. code or examples.

components.name: Chat
components.purpose: Container for an AI chat conversation including thread and prompt.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7). Includes ThreadScrollButton.

components.name: Thread
components.purpose: Scrollable list of chat messages.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7). Parts: ThreadItem, ThreadLoadMoreItem.

components.name: UserMessage
components.purpose: A message sent by the user in a chat thread.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7).

components.name: ResponseStatus
components.purpose: Shows an assistant's progress/status with expandable execution steps.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7). Parts: ResponseStatusTitle, ResponseStatusPanel, ExecutionTrace, ExecutionTraceItem.

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: Alert message shown inside a chat thread.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7). AI package Alert, distinct from InlineAlert.

components.name: MessageSuggestionList
components.purpose: List of suggested prompts the user can pick.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7).

components.name: MessageFeedback
components.purpose: Controls for rating an assistant response (e.g. thumbs up/down).
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7).

components.name: MessageSource
components.purpose: Shows a source or citation for an assistant response.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7).

components.name: PromptField
components.purpose: Prompt input with attachments, tokens, toolbar, submit and voice buttons.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7). Parts: PromptFieldAttachmentList, Attachment, AttachmentPreview, PromptFieldToolbar, PromptFieldSubmitButton, PromptFieldVoiceButton, InsertMenuButton, AttachFileMenuItem, CommandMenuItem, InsertTokenMenuItem.

components.name: PromptTokenField
components.purpose: Prompt text field that supports inline tokens (e.g. mentions, commands).
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7). PromptToken is its token part.

components.name: PixelLoader
components.purpose: Animated pixel icon shown while the AI assistant is working.
components.notes: From @react-spectrum/ai (first preview in S2 v1.7).

components.name: Alert banner
components.purpose: Prominent banner for high-signal system messages that prompt action.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Application frame
components.purpose: Shared structure for Adobe app shells (headers, panels, rails).
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Close button
components.purpose: Button used inside other components (toast, action bar) to dismiss them.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Coach mark
components.purpose: Temporary message that teaches a new feature; can chain into a tour.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Color loupe
components.purpose: Magnified preview of the color under the cursor or finger while picking.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Rating
components.purpose: Lets the user give an item a star rating.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Tray
components.purpose: Mobile-only container sliding from the bottom for menus and options.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page. In v3 React Spectrum this is Dialog type='tray' / mobile rendering of pickers.

components.name: Tab bar (iOS)
components.purpose: Top-level navigation bar for iOS apps.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Bottom navigation (Android)
components.purpose: Top-level bottom navigation for Android apps.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Field label
components.purpose: Label that gives context to a form input.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page. In React Spectrum it is the label prop of each field.

components.name: Help text
components.purpose: Description or error message under a form field.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page. In React Spectrum it is description/errorMessage props.

components.name: Headers
components.purpose: Top-of-app container for global actions, navigation, preferences and branding.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Big number
components.purpose: Single metric value with its label.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Area chart
components.purpose: Chart showing change in a metric over time as filled areas.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Bar chart
components.purpose: Chart comparing values with bars.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Donut chart
components.purpose: Chart showing proportions of a whole.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Line chart
components.purpose: Chart showing change over time with lines.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Scatter plot
components.purpose: Chart comparing two metrics across many items.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Histogram
components.purpose: Chart showing the distribution of values in bins.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Legend
components.purpose: Key explaining how chart colors or shapes map to data.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Axis
components.purpose: Chart axis with scale labels.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Scroll-zoom bar
components.purpose: Control for scrolling and zooming through chart data.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Body
components.purpose: Typography style for body text.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Detail
components.purpose: Typography style for small supporting text.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.

components.name: Code
components.purpose: Typography style for code text.
components.notes: Design-guideline page on spectrum.adobe.com only; no React Spectrum component page.
